title: Global Leadership & Merit Excellence Award (Europe)
excerpt: Discovered and indexed via Firecrawl from Europe portal details. Comprehensive funding for innovators and future leaders.
description:
## Introduction
This scholarship is sponsored by the Academic Hub Platform in partnerships with leading global institutions to support promising candidates in their academic journey.

## Value & Benefits
- Comprehensive coverage of academic tuition and college levies.
- Substantial monthly living allowance.
- Priority invitation to annual summit events.

## Eligibility Criteria
- Outstanding intellectual achievements with a GPA exceeding 3.5/4.0.
- Citizens of any country are eligible to apply.
- Candidates must submit a written personal statement (maximum 1000 words).
eligibility: Minimum 3.5 GPA with strong leadership profiles.
